item.title: Anthropic and SpaceX Sign Compute Deal for 300MW Colossus 1 Capacity
item.description: On May 6, 2026, Anthropic agreed to take all compute capacity at SpaceX's Colossus 1 data center in Memphis — more than 300 megawatts and over 220,000 NVIDIA GPUs — and immediately raised Claude API and Claude Code usage limits.

item.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5.5 Instant as New Default ChatGPT Model
item.description: OpenAI on May 5, 2026 began rolling out GPT-5.5 Instant as the new default ChatGPT model. It replaces GPT-5.3 Instant, cuts hallucination on legal, medical, and financial queries, and keeps the low-latency profile of the Instant tier.

item.title: Microsoft Agent 365 Hits General Availability with Cross-Cloud Registry and Local Agent Controls
item.description: On May 1, 2026, Microsoft made Agent 365 generally available at $15 per user per month with a unified observe-govern-secure control plane, cross-cloud registry sync with AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud, and Defender/Intune local agent management on Windows endpoints.
